title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
title_zh: MemoryTax：智能体记忆的苦涩教训

paragraphs.en: 实证研究显示模型强大到能自行搜索时精心设计的记忆系统收益有限，编码智能体表现更佳。 Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究显示，当模型强大到能自行搜索时，精心设计的记忆系统收益有限，编码智能体表现更佳。Mem0 和 Zep 等智能体记忆系统会在任何问题到来之前决定保留什么；编码智能体则保留原始历史记录，让模型用自己的工具去搜索。 我们探究的是：一旦模型强大到能够自行搜索，精心设计的记忆是否仍然有帮助。 在一个 LoCoMo 对话（419 轮，152 个问题）上，我们运行了四种记忆方法（全上下文、BM25、Mem0、Zep）和三个编码智能体（Pi、Codex、Claude Code），每种均搭配 GPT-4o-mini、GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Opus 5.5，并记录每次运行的成本。 这是一项简短的实证研究，每个组合只使用一个对话并只运行一次。 智能体记忆是对弱模型的一种代价高昂的补丁：Mem0 仅在使用 GPT-4o-mini 时胜过全上下文，而且仅其构建成本就超过了一次完整的全上下文运行。 智能体记忆还存在一个由写入它的模型所设定的上限：更强的读取者无法弥补更弱的写入者所遗漏的内容。 在 Claude Opus 5.5 上，Pi 登顶成本-准确率前沿，以不到全上下文一半的成本取得 99% 的得分；其唯一失分是一道答案键本身错误的问题。 这一领先部分来自只有智能体才能读取的照片说明文字：在证据不含照片的 88 个问题上，Pi 与全上下文仅相差一个答案。
